admission.justification: An inherited polling override or automatic WSL selection would silently restore recursive scans of the task tree and reintroduce measured background load; the native owner test pins the explicit backend and real event delivery.

applicability: The live dashboard input watcher on the supported local native POSIX/ext4 coordination roots.
conditions: After registration it performs no periodic recursive directory polling.
Existing domain filters, nested atomic-write delivery, root-set refresh, stop/drain and reported retry behavior remain.
exclusions: Unsupported mount/backend compatibility and new polling fallbacks are outside this obligation.

statement: On the supported local native POSIX/ext4 roots, use native events explicitly.
